help.selfBody: Connect a Phantom / Solflare / Backpack / OKX / MetaMask wallet. Every wish, like, and blessing is signed by you, and funds go directly from your wallet to the payee addresses. This site never touches your private key or holds funds.
help.hostBody: Entering an email generates a devnet-only key on the demo server, which signs on your behalf. The key is stored in plain text in a server file and must never be used for mainnet or real assets; production use would require KMS/HSM, identity verification, and a compliance assessment.
help.guestBody: Browse all wishes without logging in (read-only).
help.feeBody: The amount for a wish (custom card) is up to you, with a minimum of USD 1 worth of SOL (or equivalent on EVM). The full amount goes to the project's receive address for that chain; the wallet shows the recipient when you sign. Likes and blessings only cost the network fee. This project offers no returns, dividends, liquidity, or rebates of any kind.
help.modBody: Content is checked by the moderation service before payment / on-chain writing (keyword filter + AI semantic review interface + manual review queue). On approval, the service signs “content hash + result + timestamp” with ed25519, and the signature is written on-chain together with the content. The frontend re-verifies it when reading; content with a missing or invalid attestation is not displayed.
help.stageBody: The World Tree grows continuously with the number of wish cards (no final stage). Each month (Beijing time) it shifts form: days 1–10 {green}; days 11–20 {bloom}; day 21 to month end {fall}.
help.riskBody: This project is an MVP demo running on Solana devnet; test tokens have no value. On-chain content is public and cannot be deleted; this site can hide violating content in the frontend but cannot erase it from the chain.
terms.title: User Agreement / Purchase Terms
terms.1: This site is a non-custodial frontend: all writes are signed by your own wallet (or, in demo mode, by a devnet demo key), and the blockchain is the single source of truth.
terms.3: Custom card content you submit must comply with the Custom Card Content Policy:
terms.4: The purchase amount is up to you, with a minimum of USD 1 worth of SOL (or equivalent on EVM). Payment goes in full to the project's receive address for that chain; this site does not handle or hold funds and offers no returns, dividends, or rebates.
terms.5: Once on-chain, content and payments are irrevocable, unmodifiable, and non-refundable. Please check carefully before submitting.
terms.6: Each purchase creates a soul-bound “World Tree Spectrum” record bound to your address; it is non-transferable and has no financial attributes.
terms.7: Custodial demo mode is for devnet testing only and must not be used for real assets.
terms.8: Currently running on the devnet test network, for demonstration only.

help.socialBody: A social card lets you introduce yourself and meet like-minded people. The card text, tags (up to 5), intro and “looking for” are reviewed and then written publicly on-chain; they cannot be changed afterwards. Contact info is optional and stored only on this site’s server (off-chain), never on-chain; you can edit or delete it anytime under My Wishes › My cards, and choose whether to show it in the card details. Contact info is also moderated and checked against phishing lists. There is no matching, recommendation or direct messaging. Contact info is entered by the user; use your own judgment, as this site does not verify it.
help.giftBody: A gift card is a greeting card addressed to a specific address (Solana or EVM), with an optional note of up to 50 characters. The sender is the signing address; the recipient and note are written publicly on-chain. A gift card is only an on-chain display record: no tokens or assets are transferred and it carries no promise of redemption. The recipient can see it under My Wishes › Gifts received after signing in, and gets an inbox notice (if enabled). Blocked addresses cannot receive gift cards.

help.gateBody: A gate card is only an online access credential: not an asset, non-transferable (soulbound), no physical card, no promise of returns, and holding one confers no ownership. Gate cards can be issued by rules (you claim them once the conditions are met) or by an issuer, may have an expiry, and can be revoked by the issuer or an administrator. Names and benefit descriptions must pass positive-content review.
terms.9: A gate card is only an online access credential: not an asset, non-transferable, with no promise of returns or ownership. Issuers may set an expiry or revoke it, and gate card text must pass positive-content review.

gqf1.l1: May starlight guide lost hearts back to each other,
gqf1.l2: and on the long road, may they find one another.
gqf1.m: Met by a star, never apart
gqf2.l1: May a healing light fall softly on every wound,
gqf2.l2: and in the dark, may you find your whole self again.
gqf3.l1: May love, like light, cross time and never fade,
gqf3.l2: and live forever in each other’s hearts.
gqf3.m: Eternal love, kept in the heart
gqf4.l1: May every dream find its echo,
gqf4.l2: and may you walk a road that is truly your own.
gqf5.l1: May the heart that protects stay steadfast,
gqf5.l2: sheltering those you love through every storm.
gqf6.l1: May your wings open and slip every chain,
gqf6.l2: and may you soar free across the open sky.
gqf6.m: A wish for freedom, never resting
gqf7.l1: May wisdom shine like light on unknown roads,
gqf7.l2: and may searching reveal new possibilities.
gqf7.m: A wish for wisdom, always within
gqf8.l1: May the way home no longer feel long,
gqf8.l2: and may you find your true home in your heart.
gqf8.m: A wish for home will arrive
gqf9.l1: May the fire of creation never go out,
gqf9.l2: and from blank pages may new worlds be born.
gqf9.m: A wish to create, flowing endlessly
gqf10.l1: May every ending be a new beginning,
gqf10.l2: and in rebirth may you shine brighter still.
gqb1:
At the far end of the starry river there is a star that answers wishes.
Every night a child stood upon the clouds and reached for it.
Years later, when two hearts that had lost their way looked up again,
the starlight joined them once more.
Meeting was never chance — it was every wish made with care,
finally caught, gently, by the universe.
gqb2:
Someone buried every hurt deep in the dark,
until she met a tree that glowed.
Its roots wrapped softly around the broken places
and carried the light back, little by little.
The wounds did not vanish —
she simply chose to stand in the light again
and piece herself whole.
Healing was never forgetting;
it is finding the courage to hold yourself again.
gqb3:
They say love fades with time.
But when two hearts truly recognize each other,
the light grows into a tree on its own,
binding their roots tightly together.
I leave the light for you.
gqb4:
She once thought dreams were only distant stars.
Then one day the road beneath her feet began to glow.
Every step landed on light, and a door slowly opened ahead.
Dreams don’t come true as sudden miracles —
they come true because someone says the wish out loud, again and again,
and truly takes that step.
gqb5:
When the storm came, someone chose to be the shield.
The dragon did not roar;
it simply, quietly, sheltered the light and the tree beneath it.
It knew true protection is not strength —
it is, however hard the storm,
keeping the softest light beside the ones who matter most.
gqb6:
Many voices once bound her wings.
Until one day she decided to stop waiting for permission.
Light grew out of her and became a pair of wings.
She flew past every cloud she had never dared to cross,
and learned that freedom was never the absence of chains —
it is choosing to spread your wings, even when afraid.
gqb7:
Someone believed all answers were hidden in books.
Until one book opened by itself
and grew into a tree.
Light poured from between its pages,
showing him roads he had never imagined.
Wisdom is not knowing every answer —
it is never ceasing to ask,
and letting light grow in the unknown.
gqb8:
He walked so very far, believing home was long gone.
Then one night the road beneath his feet lit up.
A tree glowed in the distance, and someone waited beneath it.
A true home is never lost —
it waits quietly in your heart
until you are ready to turn back.
gqb9:
The blank page was once frightening.
Until a flame lit up in her hands and refused to die.
It turned from fire into branches and bloomed with flowers never seen before.
Creation does not begin with perfection —
it begins when you are willing to light yourself first, in the empty space.
gqb10:
Every ending looks like sinking into darkness.
But when the light rose again, she found herself blooming new flowers from old ashes.
Rebirth is not returning to the past —
it is carrying everything you’ve lived and choosing to become a brighter self.
Every fall was only so you could fly with greater strength.

wg.title: Wallet guide: connect to Guangqi with Phantom
wg.intro: Putting a wish on-chain needs your own Solana wallet. Here’s how with Phantom; it takes a few minutes. Guangqi never holds your assets or sends transactions for you.
wg.s1b: Download the Phantom wallet (browser extension or mobile app) from your app store or Phantom’s official site. Only use the official link and watch out for fake apps.
wg.s2t: Create a wallet and back up the recovery phrase
wg.s2b: Open Phantom, choose “Create a new wallet”, set a password and write the 12-word recovery phrase on paper. Nobody, including Guangqi, will ever ask for it.
wg.s3t: Get a little SOL inside Phantom
wg.s3b: Going on-chain needs the wish amount plus a small network fee, both paid from your wallet. You can use the “Buy” option inside Phantom and follow its steps (provided by third parties; Guangqi is not involved and does not buy for you).
wg.s4b: Make sure your wallet is on Solana mainnet with enough balance for the wish amount (minimum about US$1 equivalent) plus the network fee.
wg.s5b: Back on Guangqi, tap “Connect wallet”, choose Phantom and approve the sign-in in your wallet. When you make a wish card later, you confirm every transaction in your own wallet.
wg.safe: Never share your recovery phrase or private key; read the wallet pop-up before signing; Guangqi support will never DM you asking for anything.
wg.note: Wallet not ready yet? Write a free “not on-chain” wish first and put it on-chain yourself later.
rl.title: Moderation rules and response times
rl.intro: All public content on Guangqi (text and images) is moderated. These are our public standards and process.
rl.x1: Images: no sexual content, gore, hate symbols or other people’s private information; custom covers should relate to the wish and be positive.
rl.x2: Links and ads: no phishing, scams, link shorteners or unauthorized promotion; website links must be public http(s) addresses.
rl.x3: Privacy: don’t publish other people’s phone numbers, addresses, ID documents or other personal data.
rl.time: Automatic moderation happens instantly on submission (usually within seconds). User reports go to a human review queue and are usually handled within 24–72 hours, sometimes longer on holidays.
rl.rep: On a card’s detail page tap “🚩 Report”, pick a reason and submit. Content confirmed to break the rules is hidden on Guangqi; on-chain data itself can’t be deleted, but it won’t be shown on Guangqi.
rl.appeal: If you think your content was flagged by mistake, contact us via the Help page with the card link.
